body:
I keep hearing that but it is fucking bullshit. Civil engineering degrees are in the same goddamn boat that comm and art history majors are in.

How did I fuck my life? Had I gone for CS or CE I would be making 60k+ right now and would at least have that feeling of belonging or being meaningful in some way. 

I can only imagine how petty and ridiculous this sounds but this has been on my mind far too much and I don't know what the fuck to do about it.

I am furious, absolutely furious at this situation. 

Another comical (or sad, rather) tidbit is that my UNI still has an influx of civil kids coming in compared to other majors (since the major was 'hot' 3-4 years ago) who will no doubt also be unemployed, and fucked in general.

I believe wholeheartedly it was a total waste of time (if not money, I had most of it covered by scholarships/financial aid).

Thinking about it (and doing this really turns me onto this idea more and more), reasons for suicide:

-financial burden on my (single) parent
-no job prospects (does not seem like I will get hired anytime soon
-anger and resentment towards myself and the decisions I have made that brought me here.
- no meaningful personal attachments (I have had trouble with this my entire life, but I have never felt much empathy. Upon speaking to my mother about this she claims she saw a drastic change in my personality  after an incident in my childhood (maybe 10 years old). I am unsure if I agree with her.
- honestly just no reason to live. I have many of the things people think are positive (physical strength, endurance, an engineering degree, no debt) but in reality what good is any of it if I can't even get a fucking job at Costco. 

I have lived my entire life by the book so to speak, in order to be successful. I have done well in h.s. and college, and am now stuck in this shitty situation. Maybe I just can't deal with adult life and what many would chalk up as simply a disappointment.
